# ALPHA
### 預期會有錯誤

(最後更新於 05/07/2026 (日/月/年))

專為 1.12.2 設計的 SCP 整合包，已進行簡化以便與隨附的 SCP 基金會地圖達到最佳相容性。只要註明出處，請隨意使用本整合包！

我投入了大量時間製作此整合包，但後來卡在某個環節而暫時擱置。如今我終於要回來繼續開發，並看看還能做出什麼改善。

模組列表：
- CHISELS AND BITS - [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chisels-bits)
- CREATIVE CORE - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/creativecore) 或 [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/creativecore)
- CRAYFISH FURNITURE MOD - [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mrcrayfish-furniture-mod)
- LITTLE TILES - [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/littletiles)
- SCP CONTAINMENT PROTOCOL - [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/scp-containment-protocol-x)
- SCP LOCKDOWN - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/scp-lockdown) 或 [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/scp-lockdown)
- SCP OBSCURE - [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/scp-obscurity)
- SCP XK UNITY (現已更名為 SCP Overtime) - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/scp-overtime) 或 [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/scp-overtime/files/all?page=1&pageSize=20)
- SECURITY CRAFT - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/security-craft) 或 [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/security-craft)
- ZERAS SCPS - [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/zeras-scps)
